Coffee & food

What guests order

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Specialty coffee

Good aroma and body, guests write, and one calls it the best coffee in Nicosia.

Fresh sandwiches

Sandwiches, snacks and salads, and guests say they are always fresh.

Pastries

Croissants and pies in the glass counter, next to the coffee.

Fair prices

Several reviews mention good and affordable prices, student friendly too.

Work and study

Inside and outside

Beautifully designed

Guests describe a beautifully designed, cosy space with a calm atmosphere.

A company of friends

"We are the Workshop. A company of friends who love good coffee." That is how the café introduces itself. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30, Saturday until 14:00.
